observation_metadata.source: Chrome Math Academy completed-task DOM; metadata and base/earned XP joined to progress.csv
observation_metadata.checksum_encoding: FNV-1a32 of space-joined difficulty + C/I/N + m:ss; C correct, I incorrect with shown answer, N incorrect with literal No answer.
observation_metadata.scope: Reduced scoring features, not a complete activity-schema export. Task dates from CSV; elapsed times from question UI may include pauses.
known_limitations: Historical diagnostic 4748206 has a feed/question-date discrepancy documented in mathacademy-activity-schema.md.
Expected question times, internal stopping/mastery state and prior penalty caps are not exposed.
Final assessment formula was fitted after revising earlier candidates; it is not independently validated production code.

contradictions.claim: Completed implies every question was correct
Positive earned XP implies every question was correct
Earned XP divided by displayed base is a bounded correctness rate

observable: task completion chronology at minute resolution without verified time zone
task topic IDs from prior catalog reconciliation
ordered correctness and displayed elapsed seconds for the 34 sampled tasks
same-topic completion gaps, not scheduled due intervals
unidentified: per-question topic/KP identities in the reduced observations
initial repetition state, interval and diagnostic reset/merge policy
full exercise-time clock, due times and scheduler queue
per-task time of assignment and learner choice/delay
historical calibration parameters and model version
identifiability.interpretation: Agreement of a chosen scenario with activity order is a compatibility check. Without observed due/state values it is not a verified FIRe prediction. Question correctness alone cannot identify repetition-state transitions.

knowledge_profile.reason: Statuses mix activity history, queue checkmarks, and local prerequisite-ancestry inference; there are no FIRe state values or observation timestamps.
